Apple users have Continuity. What if the rest of us could have it too? 👀

I just discovered TwinDesk, and this might genuinely be one of the coolest apps I've come across.

It basically makes your Windows PC, Android phone, Mac, and other devices feel like one connected ecosystem.

🖱️ One mouse across multiple devices  
📱 View and control your Android phone directly from your PC  
🖥️ Extend your display across devices  
📋 Copy text on one device and paste it on another  
📁 Transfer files and manage your phone's files directly  
🔄 Pick up where you left off across devices  

Imagine controlling your Android phone with your Windows mouse, dragging files between devices, copying something on your phone and pasting it on your PC, or using another device as an extended display.

And you don't need to buy into one brand's ecosystem to make it work.

It's basically Apple Continuity, but for everyone.

Free, open-source, and honestly, a ridiculously cool piece of engineering.

🔗 https://twin-desk.vercel.app/

Why are we still treating our devices like separate islands? 😂

#Technology #OpenSource #Android #Windows #Productivity #SoftwareEngineering
